presentation.label: ARRAKIS
presentation.summary: A Dune-style detuned sub-octave drone: two subs beating against each other.
presentation.overview: A Dune-style detuned sub-octave drone: two subs beating against each other.
highlights: Play a sustained single note and listen for the beating suboctave layer.
usage: Add Arrakis from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a sustained single note and listen for the beating suboctave layer.
Compare the effect with bypass using the footswitch.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Arrakis.
steps: Add Arrakis from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a sustained single note and listen for the beating suboctave layer.

controls.name: Detun
controls.doc: params[5]. Beat spread between the two detuned voices. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: params[6]. Dry/wet. Default 45 (not ~0) so the effect is AUDIBLE the moment a patch loads — custom effects read params as 0 until a knob is touched, so this default is the on-load value. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
